notes.content: [list][*][p][b]New Gameplay Option[/b]: The generator can now be exploded under certain conditions – try it and see what happens![/p][/*][*][p][b]Generator Command Interface Update[/b]: Interacting with the generator is now more intuitive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better NPC Behavior[/b]: Updated navigation and NPC behavior logic.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Settings Options[/b]: Toggle the CRT effect, adjust mouse sensitivity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Improvements[/b]: Improved subtitles and removed visual artefacts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Audio Enhancements[/b]: Support of multiple simultaneous audio effects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optimized CPU Load[/b].[/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601100/ecd3969c1f6a076be6b300a00ad9256758c63c21.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601100/ecd3969c1f6a076be6b300a00ad9256758c63c21.gif"][/img][/url][/p][/*][/list]
